1.3 Purpose

1.1 Background

Archlin is a specialty chemicals manufacturing company undertaking a Phase 1 investment in integrated Supply Management capabilities.

Archlin currently operates SAP S/4HANA as the ERP system supporting in-scope planning and transactional data.

Archlin’s current planning maturity reflects integrated planning with some automation, while continued reliance on Excel-based consolidation, manual review, and planner-driven coordination creates delays in the planning cycle.

Archlin currently experiences poor inventory planning, limited supply visibility, raw material shortage visibility gaps, and delays in planning decisions caused by activities performed outside a centralized planning platform.

1.2 Phase 1 Scope

Archlin’s Phase 1 scope is focused on Supply Management capabilities covering requirements planning, supply planning, and PO/PR planning.

Archlin’s Phase 1 implementation direction is intended to strengthen planning discipline across material requirements, supply availability, and purchasing-related planning signals.

Archlin’s Phase 1 scope is expected to establish a more scalable planning foundation for future supply chain capability enhancements.

1.3 Purpose

The purpose of this Solution Blueprint is to define the Phase 1 scope, business intent, and implementation direction for Archlin’s investment in integrated Supply Management capabilities for Archlin’s specialty chemicals manufacturing business.

This Solution Blueprint documents the intended direction for improving Archlin’s supply management effectiveness through better inventory planning discipline, clearer planning visibility, improved planner productivity, and a single source of planning data.

This Solution Blueprint addresses Archlin’s need to reduce planning-cycle delays associated with Excel-based consolidation, manual review, and coordination outside a centralized planning platform.

This Solution Blueprint supports Archlin’s documented success criteria, including Inventory Reduction > 15%, Planning Cycle Reduction > 30%, improved planner productivity, and a single source of planning data.

1.4 Intended Business Outcomes

Archlin intends to improve supply management effectiveness by increasing visibility into supply constraints and raw material shortage gaps.

Archlin intends to improve inventory planning discipline by enabling more structured planning across requirements planning, supply planning, and PO/PR planning.

Archlin intends to improve planner productivity by reducing manual consolidation and planner-driven coordination outside a centralized planning platform.

Archlin intends to establish a planning foundation that supports improved decision-making and future supply chain capability enhancements.

1.3 Purpose

The purpose of this Solution Blueprint is to define the Phase 1 scope, business intent, and implementation direction for Archlin’s investment in integrated Supply Management capabilities for Archlin’s specialty chemicals manufacturing business.

Archlin currently operates with SAP S/4HANA as the ERP system supporting in-scope planning and transactional data. Archlin’s current planning maturity reflects integrated planning with some automation; however, Archlin continues to experience poor inventory planning, limited supply visibility, raw material shortage visibility gaps, and planning-cycle delays driven by Excel-based consolidation, manual review, and planner-driven coordination outside a centralized planning platform.

This Blueprint establishes the Phase 1 Supply Management solution direction for Archlin by focusing on the capabilities required to determine total requirements for products and raw materials, generate supply plans, and support procurement execution through purchase order and purchase requisition planning processes. The Blueprint also frames the need for improved planning visibility, exception-based supply management, and a single source of planning data for Archlin’s supply planning users.

The implementation purpose of this Blueprint is to provide Archlin with a documented foundation for solution design, process alignment, integration planning, and business validation during Phase 1. Archlin’s identified planning interfaces include Product Master, Customer Master, Sales Orders, Inventory Balances, Purchase Orders, and Production Orders, with a documented data refresh frequency of every 4 hours.

The intended outcome for Archlin is improved supply management effectiveness through better inventory planning discipline, clearer planning visibility, improved planner productivity, and a scalable planning foundation for future supply chain capability enhancements. Archlin’s documented success criteria include Inventory Reduction > 15%, Planning Cycle Reduction > 30%, improved planner productivity, and a single source of planning data.
